description: The current TipMaster Classic round: 25 real football (soccer) matches per game (btm = Bundesliga TipMaster, tmi = TipMaster International), each with the expert cohort’s home/draw/away split and majority pick (expertPick), and the whole crowd’s split beside it. The expert cohort is the top quarter, by career points per match, of this round’s players with at least 100 career Classic matches, a record kept since 1997. Expert predictions are published once the round’s entries close (Friday 18:00 Europe/Berlin, releaseUtc); before that released is false, expertPick and expert are null and expertSample is 0. Shares need at least 20 players.
